budget_rule: For each target and seed, compute the frozen common-class matched full budget. At each fraction, downsample both reference conditions to the same floor(full_budget*fraction) cell count. Preserve target cells and the common class vocabulary across fractions.
model_rule: Reuse frozen orthogroup feature extraction and SGDClassifier hyperparameters; use existing seed formula for source sampling and condition-specific model seeds.
blind_rule: Save and hash all 30 condition-budget-seed predictions per target before opening external target labels in a separate aggregation step.
